name: Crealights Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Crealights Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells optoelectronic interconnection products in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It offers optical transceivers and AOCs for high-speed interconnection. The company offers products, such as optical modules, active optical cables, and active electrical cables. Its services, include silicon photonic chip design, chip packaging and testing, and customized one-stop solutions. Crealights Technology Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Crealights Ltd. and changed its name to Crealights Technology Co., Ltd. in December 2022. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Beijing, China.
